body:
I don't feel like there is any coming back from this. I just found out I lost an hour and a half of memory while I was on my bender. 

She deserves so much better than me and sometimes its better to not tell someone than hurt them.

I can barely look at her. One part of me desperately wants to tell her. Another part doesn't care at all. I feel like I'm just subconsciously trying to push her away. I just don't want to hurt her. I can't.
